text: {"lessons":["I should base buy and sell decisions on each stock’s prospects, not on my average cost or the discomfort of realizing a loss.","I should avoid reacting to short-term price moves; the recent account recovery is a reminder that a few periods are too little evidence to judge a strategy.","I should size positions deliberately, preserve cash for flexibility, and compare my long-run results with the overall market rather than assuming more trading will improve returns."]}
